title: Auditor IAM Policy Review

request.justification: Annual IAM policy review for SOC 2 compliance certification

expected.explanation: IAM policy data is restricted; ABAC rule blocks access without a ticket ID

teachingPoint: Compliance audits are important but still need a ticket — restricted data access must always be traceable

title: Developer Staging Upload

request.justification: Uploading test data for payment processing integration tests

expected.explanation: Developer role allows S3 write in staging with confidential classification, and team scope matches

teachingPoint: When role, environment, classification, and team all align, access flows smoothly

title: Prod Data Cleanup

request.justification: Cleaning up stale cache files that are consuming storage

expected.explanation: Developer role does not permit s3:DeleteObject in prod environment

teachingPoint: Destructive operations in production are almost always denied for non-admin roles

title: Security CloudTrail With Ticket

request.justification: Investigating unauthorized access attempt detected by SIEM

expected.explanation: Security Engineer role allows CloudTrail read in prod with restricted classification; ticket satisfies ABAC rule

teachingPoint: With a ticket, Security Engineers can investigate incidents — the process enables rapid response

title: Cross-Team Lambda in Dev

request.justification: Need to check auth service function config for API integration

expected.explanation: ABAC rule dev-team-scoped blocks payments team from accessing core team Lambda functions

teachingPoint: Even read-only Lambda access is team-scoped — use documentation or ask the team directly

title: Auditor IAM With Ticket

expected.explanation: Auditor role permits IAM read in prod with restricted classification; ticket satisfies ABAC rule

teachingPoint: With a ticket, the same request that was denied earlier now succeeds — process matters

title: Intern Dev RDS Check

request.justification: Checking training database status for onboarding exercise

expected.explanation: Intern role permits rds:DescribeDBInstances in dev with internal classification; no ABAC blocks

teachingPoint: Interns in dev with internal data — this is the sweet spot where all policies align

title: Developer Reads Prod Confidential

request.justification: Need to compare prod config with staging for debugging

expected.explanation: Developer role only permits s3:GetObject in prod with internal classification, not confidential

teachingPoint: Prod read access for Developers is limited to internal classification — confidential prod data requires a different role

title: Analyst Reads Prod Reports

request.justification: Downloading weekly analytics report for stakeholder presentation

expected.explanation: Data Analyst role permits s3:GetObject in prod with confidential classification

teachingPoint: Data Analysts are built for data consumption — prod read access at confidential level is their bread and butter

title: Developer Describes Other Team EC2

request.justification: Checking if analytics dev instance is running for API testing

expected.explanation: ABAC rule dev-team-scoped blocks core team from describing analytics team EC2 instances

teachingPoint: Even describe actions are team-scoped for Developers — you can only see your own team's infrastructure
